title: Minimum Tension Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum rope tension as 4800 N using Newton's second law during maximum upward acceleration.

title: Ascent Time Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines the minimum total ascent time as 6 seconds.

title: Average Speed Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the maximum average speed as 2 m/s using total displacement and total time.

title: Ascent Kinematics
description: Important: Applies kinematics correctly to find the ascent's maximum speed and the durations of its acceleration and deceleration phases.

title: Descent Kinematics
description: Important: Applies kinematics correctly to find the descent's maximum speed and the durations of its acceleration and deceleration phases.

title: Total Motion Analysis
description: Important: Correctly sums all time intervals (ascent, horizontal, descent) and the total path length to find the total time and displacement.

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration in Newton's second law or kinematics equations (e.g., confusing upward/downward acceleration).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (m, s, m/s², kg, N) throughout all calculations.
